[Pedagogy review · High priority · missing-prerequisite · pf-992baf029b]
Before p5-e, add: (a) For P(x)=(x−α)^mQ(x), m>1 and Q(α)≠0, differentiate and factor out (x−α)^(m−1). Answer: P'(x)=(x−α)^(m−1)[mQ(x)+(x−α)Q'(x)]. (b) Evaluate the bracket at α. Answer: mQ(α)≠0. (c) State the multiplicity of α in P'. Answer: m−1. (d) For m=1, evaluate P'(α). Answer: Q(α)≠0. (e) Apply these results repeatedly to identify the first nonzero derivative at α. Answer: P^(m)(α)=m!Q(α)≠0; all lower-order derivatives vanish there.
Also affects: p5-e, p5-f, p5-g
